item.title: When Walmart pulls out of town, the stores next door don’t pick up its shoppers — their sales are down 20% a year later
item.description: The decline keeps getting worse, reaching about 17% in the ninth month and 20% a year after the anchor store closes.

item.title: Meet ‘Captain Keel,’ the 37-year-old steering a Bitcoin miner into the AI data center gold rush
item.description: Ben Gagnon is turning Bitfarms into Keel Infrastructure, swapping crypto for the one thing AI giants can’t get enough of: power.

item.title: NYC is spending $70 million on 5 city-run grocery stores that will price essentials 30% below retail — and bodegas are fighting back
item.description: Five stores, one in each borough, are unlikely to substantially change grocery prices in a city with nearly 1,000 supermarkets and more than 8 million...

item.title: A warning for the new Congress: Don’t stop at ‘affordability’
item.description: An affordability crisis is also a mobility crisis.
